name: Offline field notes
purpose: Capture field notes offline and restore an owner-exported backup
differentiators: Timestamped notes with a reversible local backup workflow
acceptance: Create and edit a note offline, restart the app and recover the saved text
Export notes, delete local data and restore the same notes from the export
Exercise both workflows in connected Android instrumentation tests and save actual device screenshots
constraints: Use a Java Android Gradle project with module app and real connectedDebugAndroidTest acceptance
Owner supplies the Android SDK, an authorized test device and release signing
No accounts, tracking, hidden features or network dependency; Google Play handoff is a local AAB, not automated submission
